Rental agreement – Lindenlaan 42, Riverton
This  agreement  is  between  Bergman  Rentals  (the  landlord)  and  Alex  Morgan  (the  tenant),  for  the
furnished two-bedroom home at Lindenlaan 42, 1234 AB Riverton.
Clause 1. Duration and rent
The agreement starts on 1 September 2026 and runs for an indefinite period. The rent is € 985,00 per
month,  excluding a € 95,00 advance for  gas,  electricity  and water,  and is  due on the first  day of  each
month.
Clause 2. Deposit
The tenant has paid a deposit of two months' rent (€ 1.970,00). It will be returned within one month after
the end of the tenancy, minus any costs for damage or arrears.
Clause 3. Maintenance
The  landlord  keeps  the  premises,  heating  installation  and  large  appliances  in  good  order.  The  tenant
reports defects promptly and takes care of small repairs and the garden.
Clause 4. Notice
Bergman Rentals

Both parties may end the agreement with one calendar month's notice, in writing, after the first year.
Clause 5. House rules
Subletting is not allowed without written consent. One small pet is permitted.
Signed in Riverton on 1 August 2026, in duplicate.
, R. Bergman – landlord
A. Morgan – tenant
